استصهنت (form X)

# اِسْتَصْهَنْتَ (istaṣhanta) /is.tasˤ.han.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# اِسْتَصْهَنْتِ (istaṣhanti) /is.tasˤ.han.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# اِسْتَصْهَنَتْ (istaṣhanat) /i
